title: Dimensional Rift Post-Processing Lab
description: A space ship hallway contains a glowing portal at its center that reveals the LittlestTokyo scene through a dimensional rift. The user manipulates six coupled post-processing effect parameters across both dimensions while maintaining a total 'energy budget' conservation law, and can undo/redo any adjustment step.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with EffectComposer from three/addons. Load space_ship_hallway.glb as the primary environment and place LittlestTokyo.glb scaled to fit inside a circular portal plane at the hallway's center. Use two render targets: render the Tokyo scene to a texture mapped onto the portal disc, and render the hallway scene as the main view. Camera starts inside the hallway looking toward the portal. Add OrbitControls constrained to the hallway interior. Implement six post-processing passes: UnrealBloomPass, FilmPass (noise+scanlines), ColorCorrectionShader via ShaderPass, VignetteShader via ShaderPass, DotScreenPass, and a custom GlitchPass. Create an on-screen HTML panel with six labeled sliders (0-100) controlling each effect's intensity. Implement a conservation law: the sum of all six slider values must always equal 300. When the user drags one slider up, automatically reduce the others proportionally to maintain the total. Display the current budget total prominently. Three sliders affect the hallway scene post-processing and three affect the Tokyo portal texture post-processing, creating multi-input coupling where adjusting hallway bloom redistributes energy to Tokyo-side effects. Implement full undo/redo with Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y that restores all six slider states as a group. Store up to 50 history states. Add a 'Swap Dimensions' button that animates the Tokyo scene expanding to fill the screen while the hallway shrinks into the portal over 1.5 seconds using GSAP-style tweening, swapping which set of three effects applies to which scene. Add ambient and point lights in the hallway with emissive accents on the portal rim. Play LittlestTokyo animations via AnimationMixer. Show a step counter tracking total interactions. The task requires at least 10 deliberate slider adjustments, swaps, and undo/redo operations to achieve a visually balanced result.
